transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I came in because... even on my better days, I just can't seem to shake this feeling I've been having. It feels like some of the people at my church and in my walking club are watching me. And, um, I feel like they're putting little messages about me in the church bulletin, or just hiding things about me in what they say when we're together. It's just been bothering me.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or excessively energetic?
No, I haven't. I've never felt like that. Honestly, I usually feel just the opposite... mostly just tired and down. I've never had a time where I felt overly energetic or, you know, high like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

Well, yes, I have. Sometimes, um, when the house is really quiet... I'll hear my name, or just a few words. It sounds exactly like my friend's voice coming from the kitchen or out on the porch. It's so clear that I actually answer back out loud before I remember that nobody else is even there with me.
Do the times when you hear the voice or feel people are sending you messages happen only when you’re feeling depressed?

No, it's not just when I'm feeling down. Um, there was actually a spell of several weeks where I was doing a bit better... I was getting dressed every day, eating a bit better, and just not feeling so weighed down. But even during those weeks, I still heard my name in the house. And I still thought the people at church were hinting about me. So, it seems to happen even when my mood is okay.
About how long have these experiences of people watching you or sending you messages been going on?
Well, the voices, and the messages... and just having trouble keeping my thoughts straight... that's all been happening for about eleven months now.
During the months when these experiences were happening, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, there was. Um, for a good while... definitely more than two weeks... I was just at my absolute lowest. I was feeling down pretty much all day, every day. I was barely eating, and I just kept thinking that I had failed everyone in my life. 

And right in the middle of that, when I felt the worst, I was also hearing my friend's voice in the house and believing the people at church were sending those messages about me. So, yes, they definitely happened together.
Over these eleven months, have you felt depressed for most of that time?

Yes, I have. For most of this whole eleven-month stretch, the sadness, the guilt, and just not caring about anything... it's all been there in the background. Even during the times when the voices or those suspicious thoughts about the church were a bit quieter, the depression was still there. So, yes, the depressed mood has been there for the majority of the time.
